newsitem.title: USA: E*Trade failed to renew license in 2 states.
newsitem.headline: E*Trade failed to renew license in 2 states.

text.p: E*Trade Group Inc on Wednesday said it failed to renew its broker's license in the states of Ohio and Nebraska earlier in the year because of a clerical error.
As a result, Ohio customers who made trades with the online brokerage firm between January 1 and April 14 may cancel the transactions if they choose, it said.
In Nebraska, the company was fined about $94,000, according to a E*Trade spokeswoman, who said the fine would not be material to the company's results.
